content: प्रपातः .²1 Going forth or away, departure. .²2 Falling down or into, a fall; मनोरथानामतटप्रप्रातः <ls>Ś. 6. 10</ls>; <ls>Ku. 6. 57</ls>. .²3 A sudden attack. .²4 A cascade, waterfall, the place over which water falls down; गङ्गाप्रपातान्तनिरूढशष्पं गौरीगुरोर्गह्वरमाविवेश <ls>R. 2. 26</ls>. .²5 A bank, shore. .²6 A precipice, steep rock; प्राप्ताः प्रपातनिकटं सङ्कटेन महीयसा <ls>Parṇāl. 3. 30</ls>. .²7 Falling out or loss, as in केशप्रपात. .²8 Emission, discharge, efflux, as in वीर्यप्रपात. .²9 Throwing oneself down from a rock. .²10 A particular mode of flight.
